name: CockroachDB MCP
description: Queries CockroachDB clusters in plain language: explore schemas, run SELECTs, explain plans, and opt in to writes, via a local server or the CockroachDB Cloud endpoint.

skills.name: Schema Exploration
skills.description: Lists databases, tables, and SQL users, and returns a table's schema with its columns and indexes from a live cluster.

skills.name: Read Queries
skills.description: Executes SELECT and SHOW statements and returns EXPLAIN plans, with every SQL session forced read-only by default.

skills.name: Cluster Inspection
skills.description: Returns cluster identity and version, lists nodes with liveness and locality, and shows in-flight SQL statements.

skills.name: Opt-in Writes
skills.description: Creates databases and tables and inserts, updates, or deletes rows once write tools are enabled, with WHERE required.

skills.name: Cloud Cluster Access
skills.description: Connects to every cluster in a CockroachDB Cloud organization over OAuth or an API key, or scopes a connection to one cluster.
